findings: Contact form professional detection missing — contact.html does not read ?type=professional from URL params. Add JavaScript to detect this parameter and conditionally show the professional registration form instead of the general inquiry form.
Statistics disclaimers too verbose — the demo data warnings are visible but cluttered. Replace inline <small> tags with a single banner or footnote below the stats section.
Use My Location shows coordinates — geolocation button displays raw lat/lng instead of reverse-geocoding to a city name. Integrate a geocoding API or clarify this is placeholder behavior.

Emoji icons lack alt text — emojis used as icons (🔧, ⚡, 📍, etc.) have no alt attributes because they are plain text, making them invisible to screen readers. Replace with SVG or image elements with proper alt descriptions.

M-Pesa not visually prominent in pricing payment grid — the payment methods section on pricing.html lists M-Pesa but does not emphasize it as the primary option. Consider reordering the grid or adding visual weight to the M-Pesa card.
